doc.title: Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Dick Hyman's The Age of Swing recording
summary: He recorded the album in an empty theatre at Purchase, New York, with a Basie flair.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: By the way you play on one of my new favorite albums, and that is Dick Hyman “The Age of Swing.”
Oh yeah, I like that concept because it has a Count Basie flair to it and that was the whole idea. We did it in New York State.
Yeah. Just the sound of the recording.
Oh it was done on a stage in an empty theatre, and everything was natural.
Oh I enjoyed that. Yeah we made two of those. What’s the name of that company? Alliance?
